Chapter 1428 - 8: Perfected Fleshly Body

Chapter 1428 - 8: Perfected Fleshly Body

Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong understand very well how highly Lord Chu Wei regards that mysterious lord.

They have also witnessed the other party easily breaking through the blockade circle of seven or eight Second Realm peak lords, taking the Seven-God Treasure Tree and leaving nonchalantly.

No lord dared to pursue.

Thus, they developed a curiosity about this mysterious lord.

Additionally, with Lin Yuan seemingly having some connection to this lord, they instinctively asked out of curiosity.

However, when they heard Lin Yuan's answer, they were somewhat stunned, finding it incomprehensible.

That mysterious lord who is likely approaching the legendary threshold, is he the 'Galaxy' standing before them?

"How is that possible?!"

Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong, both time lifeforms, almost thought they had misheard.

Seeing this, Lin Yuan casually explained: "The Seven-God Treasure Tree is of some use to me, so I took action to seize it."

With Lin Yuan's current power, there was no need to conceal his strength; the Seven-God Treasure Tree, although precious, was only so for ordinary lords.

But in Lin Yuan's hands...

Even if other lords knew that Lin Yuan possessed such a rare treasure, who would dare come and snatch it?

In the vast dimensional gaps, power is the foundation.

Lord Wanwei holds countless treasures, yet no one dares to seize them while he lives.

"So that's the reason..."

Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong were deep in thought.

Although Lin Yuan's answer was incredible, the two time lifeforms immediately believed most of it.

They understood Lin Yuan's character; he would not lie about such matters.

Besides, who would dare impersonate such a powerful lord? One might unwittingly bear the consequences.

"Galaxy, your strength..." Wan Chengkong asked, barely calming his nerves, voicing his doubt.

Beside him, Mother of the Screw Realm also focused her attention to listen.

Why Lin Yuan took the Seven-God Treasure Tree was of no concern to the two time lifeforms, nor a surprise.

What surprised Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong was Lin Yuan's strength.

Not long ago, Lin Yuan was still fighting back and forth with the Second Realm Gray Ancestor.

Now he stands unrivaled among the many time lords within the Wanwei space?

Such a transformation in strength... And from a First Realm time lifeform, all the way to a Second Realm peak time lord, in how short a time?

Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong did not know that when Lin Yuan fought Gray Ancestor, his strength was not at the Second Realm, but at the First Realm, just entering the thirteenth stage of the First Realm.

"Recently, I've had some breakthroughs."

Lin Yuan said, looking at the two time lifeforms.

"Some breakthroughs?" Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong both shuddered inside.

Is this considered just some breakthroughs?

"Do you need me to protect you in the Wanwei space?"

Lin Yuan asked.

He had a good impression of Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong.

When these two time lifeforms first visited Lin Yuan, they offered several hundred pounds of Time Sand.

For time lifeforms, several hundred pounds of Time Sand is no small amount, and at that time, Lin Yuan's demonstrated strength was only at a relatively strong level within Second Realm time lifeforms.

So Lin Yuan made the offer.

With his current power, protecting two ordinary time lifeforms was extremely simple.

The owner of the Time Shop, just by name, could make even non-legendary time lords wary.

Lin Yuan at this moment could achieve a similar effect.

"Galaxy... Galaxy Lord, in the Wanwei space, you need to contend for treasures. Do not worry about us."

Wan Chengkong quickly replied.

To reach the thirteenth stage, none were fools.

Lin Yuan offered them protection, which might be genuine, but if they were to take advantage of it, that would be foolish.

"Indeed, even in the worst-case scenario, we would only lose a primary battle body which we could recover in not too long, but if because of us, it delayed your contention for treasures, then we..."

Mother of the Screw Realm also quickly responded.

Given Lin Yuan's level, the treasures he contends for could not be repaid even if they sold themselves.

"If there is danger, just mention my name."

Lin Yuan did not insist further and spoke succinctly.

Using his name was not because of its great reputation; Lin Yuan had not acted much, so his name wasn't widely spread.

But mentioning Lin Yuan's name would allow him to know, and if not too far away, he could immediately assist.

"Okay."

"Thank you, Galaxy Lord."

Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong expressed their gratitude, visibly moved.

...

Mother of the Screw Realm and Wan Chengkong, both time lifeforms, ended their casual chat with Lin Yuan in a daze.

"Galaxy... Lord... is that mysterious lord?" Mother of the Screw Realm took a deep breath, her voice filled with disbelief.

Even having accepted this fact, Mother of the Screw Realm still found it incredible.

According to the information they had, the Galaxy Lord should be a time lifeform from the Chaos Void, having not experienced even a full Great Cataclysm cycle.

Under such circumstances, to possess power approaching the legendary lord level?

"Fortunately, I didn't try to snatch that Heart of the Heavenly River. " Mother of the Screw Realm thought with a lingering sense of relief amidst her shock.

It is foreseeable that if she had attempted to 'pick up a bargain' while Lin Yuan and Gray Ancestor were battling, the outcome would not have been favorable.

"There is also the possibility that the Galaxy Lord was originally a lord who, for some purpose, integrated into the Chaos Void to retrain and is now regaining their strength?"

Wan Chengkong couldn't help but voice.

Such a premier dimension space as the Chaos Void could not be easily handled by ordinary time lifeforms, nor could time lords easily shake it, but should they be willing to pay a heavy price, a time lord might still integrate into it.
